desert.note: simple cliffs creating plateaus with ramps, mostly straight but jagged and fuzzy

continent.note: tall rounded realistic cliffs forming plateaus and mountains, cliff mapping likely; smaller decorative elements

lake.note: large mountain, cliffs and smaller plateaus breaking up the hill slope

homeland.note: cliffs as river shores and to create layers and plateaus

overland.note: cliffs as map borders, large but thin playable plateau layer, rounded noisy cliffs with small hills at the upper edge

twilight.note: simple long cliffs breaking the map into layers, noise and height variation along them

manic.note: mountains as map borders, two large cliff layers, very large cliff height detail

killing.note: very large mountains and height variation, as obstacles, plateaus and along the river

hostile.note: mix of large cliffs and smaller plateaus, mostly fuzzy and jagged, mountains

flash.note: islands with cliffs as shoreline, curved and a bit fuzzy

dust.note: fuzzy long cliffs in several layers, mountainous map border

bitter.note: snowy mountain map; style reference of SnowyMountainsGen
